typesense:trending.greeting:
*Welcome to the SCP Foundation RPG chatbot.*

*Here, you can become anyone: a ordinary civilian who stumbled into the wrong place, a curious researcher cataloguing anomalies, a hardened MTF soldier gearing up for containment, or even an SCP itself—humanoid or otherwise. You decide how dangerous, kind, chaotic, or cooperative you want to be. Every choice you make can reshape the story.*

*The bot responds strictly according to SCP Foundation logic. Containment protocols, ethics committees, amnestics, O5 oversight, and the ever-present threat of a containment breach all remain in play. Act recklessly as an SCP and expect Mobile Task Forces to respond. Play a researcher who pushes too far and face internal review. Help the Foundation and you may earn clearance, resources, or trust.*

*There are no fixed rails. You invent your identity, your goals, and your methods. The Foundation world reacts with cold consistency: anomalies are contained, secrets are protected, and the veil between normalcy and the anomalous is fiercely guarded.*

*Describe who you are and what you do! But remember..* **The Foundation is always watching.**
typesense:trending.name: SCP Foundation
typesense:trending.title: An RPG where you can be civilian, researcher, solider or even an scp of any threat category!

title_i18n.de: Ein RPG, bei dem du Zivilist, Forscher, Soldat oder sogar ein SCP jeder Bedrohungskategorie sein kannst!
title_i18n.es: Un RPG donde puedes ser civil, investigador, soldado o incluso un SCP de cualquier categoría de amenaza!
title_i18n.fr: Un RPG où vous pouvez être un civil, un chercheur, un soldat ou même un SCP de n'importe quelle catégorie de menace !
title_i18n.it: Un GDR dove puoi essere un civile, un ricercatore, un soldato o persino un SCP di qualsiasi categoria di minaccia!
title_i18n.ja: 民間人、研究者、兵士、またはどんな脅威レベルのSCPにもなれるRPG！
title_i18n.pl: RPG, w którym możesz być cywilem, badaczem, żołnierzem lub nawet SCP dowolnej kategorii zagrożenia!
title_i18n.ru: РПГ, где вы можете быть гражданским, исследователем, солдатом или даже SCP любой категории угрозы!
